name: Fleece Blanket -  US
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:

- Crafted from premium Double Face Fleece, made with 100% polyester at 300 GSM, this blanket offers a soft, cozy, and comfortable feel on both sides.

- The tightly stitched construction provides added durability for long-lasting everyday use.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:
- Available in sizes: 30x40 inches, 40x50 inches, 50x60 inches, 60x80 inches
📌 Note: Due to manual measurement, there may be an error of 1–3 cm.

 

Printing Technology:

- Featuring sublimation, the blanket showcases your custom photos, artwork, patterns, and personalized designs with clear and detailed results across the printable surface. 

- The soft fleece material provides a comfortable base for vibrant, personalized prints.

 

Functional & Usage:

- Designed for both comfort and everyday versatility, this lightweight fleece blanket is perfect for staying warm at home, relaxing on the sofa, traveling, camping, picnics, or covering beds and cribs.

- Its soft double-face fleece construction makes it cozy and comfortable while remaining easy to care for.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

-  With its customizable design and practical everyday use, this fleece blanket makes a thoughtful personalized gift for baby showers, birthdays, Christmas, Mother's Day, Father's Day, weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, or other special occasions. 

- Add a meaningful photo, name, message, or unique artwork to create a memorable gift for family and friends.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 2-3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 5-7 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xFleece Blanket 

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 1-3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
